# MyBrowser MCP installation for agents

MyBrowser has two parts: an MCP server launched by the user's MCP client and an unpacked Chrome extension. Prefer the same-device setup below unless the user explicitly requests remote browser control.

## Same-device setup

1. Add the ordinary local MCP server to the user's client with this command and arguments:

   ```text
   npx -y @alessai/mybrowser-mcp
   ```

2. Download the latest `mybrowser-extension-*-chrome.zip` and extract it to a stable folder:

   ```text
   https://github.com/alessai/MyBrowser-MCP/releases/latest
   ```

3. Chrome requires one manual trust step that must not be bypassed. Ask the user to open `chrome://extensions`, enable Developer mode, choose Load unpacked, and select the extracted extension folder.

   The first-install tutorial opens automatically. Ordinary local use defaults to `127.0.0.1:9009` and needs no CMD installer, no popup settings, and no auth-token entry.

4. Verify the result with MyBrowser's `browser_diagnostics` or `list_browsers` tool. A connected browser must appear before claiming installation succeeded.

## Existing Windows installation

The Windows installer remains optional for an existing installer-managed copy. If used, rerun `install-mybrowser.cmd`, let the user close Chrome when prompted, and do not force-kill Chrome. Reopen Chrome and verify the connected extension version with `browser_diagnostics`.

## Safety boundaries

- Do not request Administrator or UAC elevation.
- Do not edit Chrome profile databases, registry policy, or extension storage directly.
- Do not use `--hub` or `--ensure-hub` for the default same-device setup.
- Hub and remote setup still require a token; never display that token in chat or logs.
- Do not use `0.0.0.0` for a same-device setup. Remote access requires an explicit user request and a trusted tunnel or network.
- Do not claim Chrome's one-time Load unpacked approval can be automated on ordinary unmanaged Chrome.
- Do not report success until the MCP tool surface can see a connected browser.

Full documentation: https://github.com/alessai/MyBrowser-MCP#readme
